def shuffled(xs: list[int], seed: int) -> list[int]:
    """A permutation of xs whose order is determined only by seed.

    The same xs and seed always give the same result. The input is not
    modified. Uses a seeded pseudo-random generator with wrapping-safe
    arithmetic, so no 64-bit overflow can occur for any seed.
    """
    post out.len() == xs.len()
    post sorted(out) == sorted(xs)
    ex shuffled([], 7) == []
    ex shuffled([5], 3) == [5]
    ex shuffled([1, 2, 3], 5) == shuffled([1, 2, 3], 5)
    m = 2147483648
    state = (seed % m + m) % m
    res = xs.copy()
    n = res.len()
    for i in range(n - 1, 0, -1):
        state = (state * 1103515245 + 12345) % m
        j = (state // 65536) % (i + 1)
        tmp = res[i]
        res[i] = res[j]
        res[j] = tmp
    return res
